name: dsh-release-proof
description: Verify anonymous release mirrors and produce reproducible content-addressed evidence for DeepSeek Harness.

interface.shortDescription: Verify release mirrors and emit reproducible evidence.
interface.longDescription: Checks anonymous release mirrors against an explicit manifest for HTTP status, byte length, SHA-256 and version consistency, then writes a content-addressed evidence JSON file.
defaultPrompt: Verify this release manifest across every declared source and return its content-addressed evidence.
